summary: Static keyword co-occurrence in @zannstore/baileys utility module
details: @zannstore/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A single pattern matched on keyword co-occurrence (`ping`, `GET`, `id`) inside lib/Utils/generics.js, which is a standard utilities module in the Baileys codebase (WebSocket ping/keepalive, message id generation, HTTP helpers). No hardcoded attacker destination, credential path read, install/import-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, or lifecycle script was identified in the package. `ping` and `GET` in this file are consistent with the library's documented WhatsApp protocol keepalive and media helpers rather than exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
